claims: Apollo is the Olympian god of prophecy, music, song, poetry, archery, healing, plague, and protection of the young.
Apollo is often depicted with a golden bow and arrows.
Apollo is often depicted with a lyre.
Apollo is the patron deity of Delphi.
Apollo is associated with light and the sun.
Apollo's symbols are laurel wreath, raven, lyre, and bow.
The NASA Apollo Program ran from 1961 to 1972.
The NASA Apollo Program was a United States program that landed the first humans on the Moon.
Apollo 11 successfully landed Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin on the Moon on July 20, 1969.
The NASA Apollo Program involved 12 men walking on the Moon.
The NASA Apollo Program spanned 17 missions including uncrewed tests.
The NASA Apollo Program ended with Apollo 17 in 1972.
Apollo App is an AI application for accessing local and open-source language models.
The Apollo Theater is a music hall in Harlem, New York City.
